$comment: Each exception is narrow (one advisory, one package, a maximum version) and expires. scripts/security-audit.mjs fails the build when an exception expires, when a patched release of the package exists, when the advisory is no longer reported (remove the exception), or when the package appears in deployed artifacts.

exceptions.reason: No patched release exists (advisory published 2026-10-19 lists affected <=4.0.7, patched: none; npm latest is 4.0.7).
exceptions.exposure: Build and test tooling only: vite/vitest/tinyglobby/fdir, @tanstack/start-plugin-core, @tanstack/router-utils, @tanstack/devtools-bundler-core, typescript-eslint. picomatch matches file-path globs from those tools' own configuration; no customer input reaches it. It is not imported by application code and is absent from the deployed Worker bundle and browser assets (verified on every run).
